decisions.reason: A yogurt on fruit puree sits close to the core cultured-dairy line and carries little risk, so without evidence of a shortfall against aspirations there is no trigger for problemistic search.
The Abendbrotkäse is featured on the home page as a flagship, so management's commitment and its slack will carry it while results are still uncertain.
A semi-hard cheese wheel extends the established cheese range at low cost and uses existing farmer milk supply, so it is likely to stay unless it clearly underperforms.
The spicy cheese line has several variants, so the firm is more likely to prune weak variants than drop the whole line, which supports keeping it.
The mild creamy soft cheese was promoted as rounding off the new range and fits the soft-cheese assortment, so it should be retained while its results develop.
A washed-rind soft cheese is a more niche product and the most likely to miss sales aspirations, but one year is too short to justify dropping it.
